correctness.rationale: Walsh spectral diagonalization gives exact Krawtchouk distance kernels; Q3 positive expressions and coordinate marginalization cover dimensions 1–3. At h=3/2 all eigencomponents of Walsh weight at least two are negative, so the rational witness t_{4,0}=-3/1804 propagates by binomial monotonicity to every higher cube. On Q4, positive off-diagonal numerators and the two-sign-change diagonal polynomial prove precisely two positivity intervals. Nine exact symbolic identities and 124 direct rational inversion entries replayed using verify.py. Infinite-dimension statement is analytic, not inferred from tests.

value.rationale: Determines the sharp structural dimension threshold and first exact positivity-reentry window for a classical third-order, L-stable implicit integrator on a natural Cartesian diffusion family. The universal 3/2-step failure and explicit Q4 algebraic boundaries distinguish entrywise positivity from conventional A/L stability and give precise numerical-design guidance without scanning timesteps.
